title: 第5章 七十二变第6章 传法
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
周厉将卷宗翻了两遍，皱了皱眉。
“这人有问题，此事是何人当的差，将他叫来！”
片刻之后，那持哭丧棒的鬼差跪在堂下。
周厉询问了一些事情具体经过，便让其回去。
“这事你怎么看？”
他询问旁边一直不说话的崔衡。
他毕竟是刚上任不久，经验不足，之所以能做此地城隍，也是因为护国有功，受百姓敬仰，比不上崔衡这老牌鬼仙。
崔衡开口道：“依下官判断，此人多半是用了尸解之法。以桃木杖代替肉身，再设障眼法蒙蔽鬼差耳目，待时辰一过，魂魄脱离生死簿束缚，便算成了鬼仙。”
周厉眯起眼：“尸解？”
崔衡点头道：“此法虽罕见，却非无迹可循。古来野修多走此路，以巧术避开勾魂，从而阴中超脱。此人如今既已成了鬼仙……”
他顿了顿，斟酌用词：“鬼仙者，阴中超脱，神像不明，鬼关无姓，三山无名。不归阎君管辖，不在仙籍之上。乃天地间一缕游魂，得了些道行，虚无缥缈，上不着天，下不着地。”
周厉沉默片刻：“那依你之意，便放任不管？”
崔衡低头：“若按旧例，确实如此。鬼仙不入仙籍，也不归阴司管束，历来各地城隍遇上此等事，大多睁一只眼闭一只眼。”
“此人可有背景？”周厉忽然问。
崔衡一愣，翻开卷宗又看了一遍：“无师承，无仙籍，无宗门，亦无任何修行门派的记录。只是伏龙山上一个独居的野修。”
周厉嗤了一声。
“无背景？一个无名无姓的野修，用些旁门左道的把戏，骗过我城隍府的鬼差，从本座眼皮子底下溜走。这事若传出去，本座这城隍还怎么当？”
崔衡心里咯噔一下。
周厉生前是楚国司马，行军打仗出身，杀伐果断，面子比天大。上任三个月，已经撤了两批差役，就是为了立威。这种事若被他轻轻放过，那才叫见了鬼，况且这人居于山中，乃是个野人，像这些贵族出身，自古便看不起这些居于城外的野人。
“城隍的意思是……”

“打杀。”周厉平静道。
崔衡嘴巴张了张。
周厉扫了他一眼：“怎么？觉得本座做得过了？”
“下官不敢。只是鬼仙再弱也是仙，若要动手，寻常鬼差怕是不够。”
“本座自然知道。”周厉提笔蘸墨，在一张令牌上写下几个字，盖上城隍大印，“传日游神，持本座令牌，即刻前往伏龙山彻查。若那陶潜还在山上，直接拿了带回。若已逃走，便循着踪迹追。”
崔衡接过令牌，领命离去。
……
猴子的天赋，远比陶潜预想的还要离谱。
三个时辰。
仅仅三个时辰，这猴子便将迷仙障从入门修至圆满。要知道陶潜当年修这门法术，足足花了三年光景。
猴子收了法印，冲陶潜嘿嘿一笑：“陶老道，我练成了！”
陶潜没搭话，心头一动，果然，脑海中那本云笈道枢再度泛起微光，书页哗哗翻动，金色小字逐行浮现。
content_en:
Zhou Li flipped through the file twice and frowned.
"There is something wrong with this man. Who is responsible for this? Call him!"
After a while, the ghost messenger holding the mourning stick knelt down in the hall.
Zhou Li asked him about the details of the matter and then asked him to go back.
"What do you think about this?"
He asked Cui Heng, who had been silent next to him.
After all, he had just taken office recently and lacked experience. The reason why he was able to become the city god here was because he had served the country well and was respected by the people. He was not as good as Cui Heng, a veteran ghost immortal.
Cui Heng said: "According to my judgment, this person probably used the method of corpse dismemberment. He used a peach wood staff to replace the body, and then set up a blind method to blind the ghost's ears and eyes. When the time passed, the soul was freed from the shackles of the book of life and death, and he became a ghost immortal."
Zhou Li narrowed his eyes: "Autopsy?"
Cui Heng nodded and said: "Although this method is rare, it is not without traces. Wild cultivators have often followed this path in ancient times, using clever techniques to avoid seduction and achieve transcendence in the underworld. This person has now become a ghost immortal..."
He paused and considered his words: "Ghost immortals are detached in the underworld, with unknown gods. The ghost gates have no surnames, and the three mountains have no names. They are not under the jurisdiction of Lord Yama, and they are not in the immortal book. They are just a wandering soul between heaven and earth. They have acquired some Taoism. They are ethereal and cannot reach the sky or the earth."
Zhou Li was silent for a moment: "Then you just want to let it go?"
Cui Heng lowered his head: "If we follow the old rules, it is indeed the case. Ghosts and immortals do not belong to the immortal family, nor are they under the control of the underworld. Historically, the city gods from all over the world turned a blind eye when encountering such things."
"Does this person have a background?" Zhou Li suddenly asked.
Cui Heng was stunned for a moment, then opened the file and read it again: "No teacher, no immortal book, no sect, and no record of any practicing sect. He is just a wild cultivator living alone on Fulong Mountain."
Zhou Li snorted.
"No background? A nameless wild cultivator used some unorthodox tricks to deceive the ghost servants of my City God's Mansion and slipped away from under my nose. If this matter is spread, how can I, the City God, still act as a God?"
Cui Heng's heart skipped a beat.
Zhou Li was a Sima of the Chu State during his lifetime. He had a background in marching and fighting. He was decisive in killing and had a great reputation. Three months after taking office, two batches of police officers have been withdrawn, just to establish his authority. If he let this kind of thing go lightly, it would be like seeing a ghost. Besides, this man lives in the mountains and is a savage. People like these nobles have looked down on these savages living outside the city since ancient times.
"City God means..."
"Kill." Zhou Li said calmly.
Cui Heng opened his mouth.
Zhou Li glanced at him: "What? Do you think I have gone too far?"
"I don't dare. It's just that ghosts and immortals are still immortals no matter how weak they are. If we want to take action, ordinary ghosts and demons may not be enough."
"Of course I know." Zhou Li dipped his pen in ink, wrote a few words on a token, and stamped it with the city god's seal. "The God of Traveling in the Sun, holding my token, immediately went to Fulong Mountain to conduct a thorough investigation. If Tao Qian is still on the mountain, take it directly and bring it back. If he has escaped, follow the traces."
Cui Heng took the token and left with the order.
…
Monkey's talent is far more outrageous than Tao Qian expected.
Three hours.
In just three hours, this monkey has cultivated the Immortal Obscurity from the beginning to perfection. You must know that it took Tao Qian three years to practice this magic.
The monkey took away the seal and smiled at Tao Qian: "Old Tao, I've mastered it!"
Tao Qian didn't say anything, but his heart moved. Sure enough, the Yunji Daoshu in his mind shimmered again, the pages flipped, and the small golden characters appeared line by line.
